steps: Append module6Questions through module19Questions (skipping M17) to the end of src/features/question-bank/data/fixed-income.ts after the existing module5Questions array

Module 6: Fixed-Income Bond Valuation: Prices and Yields (24 Qs) - Bond pricing with PV, price/YTM relationship, premium/discount/par, pull-to-par, matrix pricing, flat vs full price, accrued interest
Module 7: Yield and Yield Spread Measures for Fixed-Rate Bonds (15 Qs) - Current yield, YTM, YTC, yield-to-worst, G-spread, I-spread, Z-spread, OAS, BEY

Module 8: Yield and Yield Spread Measures for Floating-Rate Instruments (14 Qs) - FRN coupon (ref rate + spread), quoted vs required margin, discount margin, FRN pricing, interest rate risk, reset risk, cap/floor

Module 9: The Term Structure of Interest Rates (23 Qs) - Spot rates, par curve, forward rates, spot-forward relationship, yield curve shapes, expectations theory, liquidity preference, segmented markets, preferred habitat

Module 10: Interest Rate Risk and Return (25 Qs) - Bond price vs yield inverse relationship, reinvestment risk, price risk, investment horizon, duration gap, Macaulay duration and investment horizon matching

Module 11: Yield-Based Bond Duration Measures (26 Qs) - Modified duration calculation, approximate modified duration, effective duration for callable bonds, key rate duration, duration of portfolio, duration of zero-coupon bond

Module 12: Yield-Based Bond Convexity and Portfolio (28 Qs) - Approximate convexity, convexity adjustment, money convexity, portfolio convexity, callable bond negative convexity, MBS negative convexity
Module 13: Curve-Based and Empirical Risk Measures (33 Qs) - Effective duration, effective convexity, key rate duration, spread duration, empirical duration, hedging with duration, portfolio DV01
Module 14: Credit Risk (13 Qs) - Expected loss, POD, LGD, recovery rate, credit spread, credit migration, default risk, credit VaR
Module 15: Credit Analysis for Government Issuers (7 Qs) - Sovereign credit analysis, fiscal/monetary flexibility, institutional strength, external vulnerability
Module 16: Credit Analysis for Corporate Issuers (20 Qs) - Coverage ratios, leverage ratios, capacity to pay, collateral, character, conditions, covenants analysis
Module 18: ABS Instrument and Market Features (17 Qs) - ABS structure, SPV, tranching, credit enhancement (internal/external), auto loan ABS, credit card receivable ABS, waterfall structures
Module 19: MBS Instrument and Market Features (23 Qs) - MBS types (pass-through, CMO, RMBS, CMBS), prepayment risk, PSA model, CPR, SMM, WAC, WAM, contraction/extension risk

After all module arrays, add the combined export: export const fixedIncomeQuestions: Question[] = [...module1Questions, ...module2Questions, ..., ...module19Questions] (all 18 module arrays, skipping M17)
